title: Note Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 🗒️note plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗒️note/, crate semio-s-plugin-note) to the newly-amended Shape V2 tree-purity rule. Under the owner root, only component.<ext> files, the 📦️packages folder, and plain taxonomy folders (containing only those three at every level) may exist. Concretely: (1) move 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, update Cargo.toml [lib] path, and prefix every #[path] string inside it with ../../ since it now sits two levels deeper; (2) fold any sibling variant files (e.g. 🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs, 🦀️wasm.rs sitting beside a 🦀️component.rs) into their own component folders, updating #[path]/mod wiring and any use crate::... references, without changing module content or identifiers; (3) relocate any nested 📚️examples/, 🧫️fixtures/, 🤖️generated/, 🛂️manifest.json found buried in the tree up to the owner root (sibling of 📦️packages), fixing any code that references the old data path; (4) relocate any nested AGENTS.md/README.md to the owner root byte-for-byte, flagging any collision instead of merging. Pure mechanical relocation, no logic changes. Strictly scoped to ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗒️note/** only — no edits to root Cargo.toml, other plugins, .vscode/launch.json, or the registry generator. Follows the recipe in CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md §14.
summary: Retrofitted the already-migrated 🗒️note plugin to the Shape V2 tree-purity rule. Moved 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (updated Cargo.toml [lib] path from "../../📦️lib.rs" to "📦️lib.rs"; prefixed all 36 #[path] strings — and every "." grouping path — with ../../ since the file now sits two levels deeper). Folded the two sibling variant files that sat beside 🎛️apps/🗒️note/🦀️component.rs into their own component folders, matching the same folder-naming convention already used by the sibling 📖️playbook plugin: 🦀️config.rs -> 🎚️config/🦀️component.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs -> 🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs (module identifiers `config`/`terminology` unchanged, only their #[path] targets moved). Relocated the orphan 🛂️manifest.json from 🗿️artifacts/🗒️note/🛂️manifest.json to the owner root (sibling of 📦️packages) — it was unreferenced by any code (no include_str!/include_bytes! or path string pointed at it), so no reference fixes were needed. 📚️examples/🗒️semio.note was already correctly sitting at the owner root; no AGENTS.md/README.md exist anywhere in the tree (confirmed via find), so no collision. Pure mechanical relocation — git diff confirms config.rs/terminology.rs/manifest.json moved byte-identical (100% similarity, zero content diff); only lib.rs's doc-comment + #[path] strings and Cargo.toml's single path line actually changed. Verified every #[path] target in the new lib.rs resolves to a real file on disk (36/36 OK), and a final recursive find confirms the tree under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗒️note now contains only 🦀️component.rs files, 📦️packages, and plain taxonomy folders (plus the owner-root 📚️examples/ and 🛂️manifest.json data, per rule 3). Root Cargo.toml's member line already pointed at 📦️packages/🦀️rust and needed no change; repo-wide grep for the old 🔌️plugins/🗒️note/📦️lib.rs path found no live code references (only an .nx cache entry and an old closed ticket record). cargo check/clippy/test -p semio-s-plugin-note were attempted repeatedly (including a final retry) but stayed blocked workspace-wide throughout the whole session by the known live norm-migration issue (dangling manifest path at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔨️modules/🫀️core/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust — directory genuinely absent on disk, confirmed not my bug) — identical failure before and after my changes, so no drift was introduced; verification was therefore manual (git diff content-equality + on-disk #[path] resolution + tree-purity find), not a green cargo run. Files touched: moved ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗒️note/📦️lib.rs -> 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (content: doc comment + #[path] strings updated); moved 🎛️apps/🗒️note/🦀️config.rs -> 🎛️apps/🗒️note/🎚️config/🦀️component.rs (unchanged); moved 🎛️apps/🗒️note/🦀️terminology.rs -> 🎛️apps/🗒️note/🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs (unchanged); moved 🗿️artifacts/🗒️note/🛂️manifest.json -> 🛂️manifest.json (unchanged); updated 📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.toml ([lib] path only).
